svg.title: Kristallnacht (9–10 Nov 1938), Mass Internment & Forced Jewish Emigration (1938–39)
svg.desc: Historical GIS atlas map of the November 1938 Greater German Reich (incorporating March 1938 Anschluss Austria, October 1938 Sudetenland, and East Prussia), charting the Zbąszyń deportation and Paris assassination pretext, Goebbels’ Munich incitement, nationwide synagogue burnings, mass internment of 30,000 Jewish men in Dachau, Buchenwald, and Sachsenhausen, the July 1938 Évian Conference, and the 1938–39 Kindertransport rescue route to Britain.

g.text: Rounded up to Dachau, Buchenwald & Sachsenhausen

svg.text: EDEXCEL GCSE HISTORY · PAPER 3 (OPTION 31) · KT4.4: PERSECUTION OF MINORITIES
Kristallnacht (9–10 Nov 1938), Mass Internment & Forced Jewish Emigration (1938–39)
On 9–10 Nov 1938 (Kristallnacht), SA/SS mobs burned synagogues, smashed 7,500 Jewish shops, murdered 91 Jews, and interned 30,000 Jewish men;
Göring’s 1 billion mark fine, forced Aryanisation, and Heydrich’s Jan 1939 Emigration Office drove over half of German Jews into exile by Sept 1939.
